Check that a mapper's input has the right column names

Source: R/mapper-function-helpers.R
check_mapper_input_colnames.Rd

check_mapper_input_colnames() is superseded by function_map(), whose mappers check their input columns themselves.

Call it in a handwritten mapper. It errors if data lacks a key column, or if it already has a column named like the key result column ("consistency" by default).

Usage

check_mapper_input_colnames(
  data,
  reported,
  name_test,
  name_key_result = "consistency"
)

Arguments

data

Data frame. Input to the mapper.

reported

String. Names of the key columns that data must have, such as c("x", "n") for grim_map().

name_test

String (length 1). Plain-text name of the test, such as "GRIM", for the error message.

name_key_result

String (length 1). Name of the result column that the mapper adds. Default is "consistency".

Value

No return value; might throw an error.

See also

vignette("consistency-tests-in-depth").
